If you live life cutting corners, it'll come back to bite you someday.

original: 今はね、仕事を見つけるのも楽じゃないよ。

en.text: It's not easy to find work nowadays.
It isn't easy to find work nowadays.
It's not easy to find a job nowadays.
It isn't easy to find a job nowadays.

original: 薬のおかげで楽になったよ。

en.text: Thanks to the medicine, I feel better now.

original: この仕事は決して楽じゃないんだ。

en.text: This work is anything but easy.

original: 「身長があと10cm高かったら、窓のガラス磨きが楽なんだけどな」「ないものねだりしても仕方ないよ。椅子持ってきてあげたよ」

en.text: "If I was just 10 cm taller, it wouldn't be any effort for me to polish these glass windows." "It's no good wishing for the moon. Here, I've brought you a chair."

original: バッグに入る大きさなので持ち運びは楽ですね。

en.text: It's small enough to fit in a bag, so it's easy to carry.

original: 僕ができる言葉なら、どれで話しかけてくれてもいいけど、一番楽なのはフランス語だよ。

en.text: You can talk with me in any of my languages, but I'm most comfortable with French.

original: 言いたいこと全部言ったら、気持ちが楽になったわ。

en.text: I felt quite relieved after I had said all I wanted to say.

original: 楽な方に流されて生きてると、私みたいになるよ。

en.text: If you live always taking easy way, you'll become like me.

original: 薬を飲めば楽になるよ。

en.text: If you take medicine, you will feel better.
